purpose: Grant of land and provisions by the king for the periodic bathing and limb-worship (snapanāṅgapūjā) of the deity Rājyavardhanadeva
notes: The inscription records an ordinance (kriyākāra) and grant of land made by an unnamed reigning king ('mayā ... rājñā', lines 5–6; 'madūrddhvaṃ ye nṛpāḥ', line 7; 'svavaṃśyān-anurakṣatā', line 8), whose name is lost in the damaged opening. The beneficiary 'Rājyavardhanadeva' is the deity/liṅga receiving ritual bathing and worship (lines 4 and 6), not a human person.
